title: DAM Population Seed - CI subset (v2026.11.01-sm)
subtitle: Coverage-selected 165-asset subset of the studio archive, for pull-request CI
description:
A small, coverage-selected subset of the DAM Population Seed studio archive (full edition `v2026.11.01`, 2,005 assets). It is built for **pull-request CI**: it holds exactly the rows and files Artist Alley's `aa seed --profile ci` selects, plus the two declared cross-peer overlap anchors, so a CI run can seed a fixture that still covers every one of the 131 coverage dimensions without downloading the full edition.

**Contents:** 165 assets across 6 media types (84 image, 41 3d, 14 document, 9 audio, 9 video, 8 font) and 91 posts. 9 of the full edition's 92 videos are included. `MANIFEST.json` carries per-asset metadata; `posts.json`, `groups.csv` and `metadata.csv` carry the relational structure, filtered to the included rows (group counts are the included members). Every included row is byte-identical to the full edition; `EDITION.json` records what was selected, how, and what was removed.

**MATURE-CONTENT LABEL.** Every asset carries a boolean `mature` in `MANIFEST.json`. 6 included assets are labelled `true` (public-domain fine-art nudes and life studies), all in one post. See ATTRIBUTIONS.md.

**LICENSING IS MIXED: read before redistributing.** There is no single aggregate licence. Every asset carries its own `license` and `attribution` in `MANIFEST.json`, unchanged from the full edition, and `ATTRIBUTIONS.md` lists the licence and attribution pairs this edition actually contains. 1 included video is U.S. National Park Service B-roll whose public-domain label is provisional; see ATTRIBUTIONS.md. Honour the per-asset terms.

This subset is not published to Kaggle; the `id` differs from the full dataset's (`mscrnt/dam-population-seed`) so it can never be uploaded as a version of it.
